tione العرم sæpius memorata, migrare coacti, sedem
ad aquam in Syria quæ غسان Gassan appellata
est fixerunt, atque inde denominati sunt. Ante eos Syriam
occupârunt Arabes الضجاعه AlDajaamii

occisis succefserunt.
1 جفنة Jafnah f. Amri, f. Thaalaba, f. Amri, fil.
Maxikia, cujus imperio, occisis Regibus Salihensibus,
submiserunt se Arabes Kodaenses,&qui in Syria Damascena
erant Graci, الروم
2 عمرو= Amrus Jafna filius: qui in Syria multa
struxit {*}Monasteria veluti دير ايوب & دير برخالن & دير هند &
3 ثعلبة Thaalabah, Amri filius.
4 الحارث AlHareth, leu Aretas, Thaalaba filius.
5 جبلة Jabalah, AlHarethi filius.
6 الحارث AlHareth, Jabala filius.
7 المنذر الاكبر AlMondar AlAcbar, i.e. Maximus, Harethi filius.
8 النعمان AlNooman, AlMondari frater.
9 جبلة Jabalah, ejusdem frater.
10 الايهم Altham, eorundum frater.
11 عمرو Amrus, prædictorum etiam frater.
12 جفنة الاصغر Jafnah alasgar, i.e. Minor, والمنذر
الاكبر Al-Mondari Alacbari filius; Hic urbem Hiram incendit,
inde ipsius posteri ال الحرق [?] i.e. Familia incendiarii
dicti.
13 النعمان الاصغر AlNooman alAsgar, ipsius
frater.
14 النعمان AlNooman, f. Amri, f. AlMondari,
volunt

page.notes: Left margin note: "Sen, vicos." with an Arabic gloss, transcribed as far as legible; the gloss is uncertain. Arabic words throughout are copied from the scan and may contain letter-level errors; the Arabic in lines 2 and 12 is least certain. "ال الحرق" in item 12 is doubtful. Item 14 breaks off at "volunt" and continues on the next page. Printed "Asgar" in item 13 and "alasgar" in item 12 read as long s, transcribed as plain s.
